name: Green Data Center Zurich West 4 / Campus ZRH1 Lupfig
notes: Green announced construction of the fourth data center at its Metro-Campus Zurich West / Campus ZRH1 headquarters in Lupfig. The release says 5,526 m2 of new data center space, 12 MW output for customer systems, waste-heat extraction, 100% renewable operations, and commissioning in 2026; Green's current campus page says the fourth data center is under construction and expected from early 2027.

name: FlexBase Technology Center Laufenburg AI Data Center
notes: FlexBase says construction of the Technology Center Laufenburg, including an AI data center and battery storage facility, began in spring 2025. The project overview describes a 40,000 m2 campus combining battery storage, an AI data center, offices and laboratories; ERNE describes a new technology-center building in Laufenburg with a data center for AI and a >500 MW battery-storage facility. Public sources did not consistently disclose IT MW, so capacity_mw is null.

Targeted searches for Appenzell Innerrhoden / AI with data center, datacenter, Rechenzentrum, colocation, cloud region, hyperscale, and server farm terms found no public data center project or facility in this canton. Appenzell-region hits were for Gais in neighboring Appenzell Ausserrhoden.

name: Rechenzentrum Ostschweiz Gais
developer: Rechenzentrum Ostschweiz AG / St. Gallisch-Appenzellische Kraftwerke AG and St. Galler Stadtwerke
notes: SAK describes Rechenzentrum Ostschweiz as a highly available, energy-efficient communications hub in Gais AR, with Tier IV level availability, PV on facade/roof, adiabatic cooling, and waste-heat reuse by a neighboring cheese factory. RZO's site states it has data-center locations in Gais AR and Gossau SG. DataCenterMap lists the RZO facility as a 1 MW operational colocation data center; MW is from the third-party directory.

name: NorthC Biel (Bern) Data Center
notes: NorthC's official Biel (Bern) facility page lists a 3,380 m2 data center with 4 MW installed electrical capacity, built to Tier 3 standards. NorthC acquired the Swiss platform from Netrics in 2022, including the Biel site.

name: Swisscom Bern-Wankdorf Data Center
notes: Swisscom's official data-center page states it operates seven Swiss data centers for business customers and lists Bern-Wankdorf among its sites. Public operator materials found during this run did not disclose site-level MW capacity.

name: NorthC Arlesheim (Basel) / uptownBasel data center
notes: NorthC announced a contract to build and operate a regional data center at the uptownBasel innovation campus in Arlesheim. The first expansion phase is 2,500 m2 with 6 MVA supply, about 5.5 MW usable capacity; commissioning is targeted for mid-2027 after building-permit approval and an approximately 18-month construction period.

name: NorthC Muenchenstein (Basel) 1 Data Center
notes: NorthC's official page describes the Muenchenstein (Basel) 1 facility at Weidenstrasse 41, 4142 Muenchenstein, as an operational high-density data center in Muenchenstein's economic zone near Basel. The 2022 acquisition release says NorthC's Swiss transaction included two Muenchenstein facilities and one Biel facility totaling about 13,000 m2 and over 7.5 MW across the three sites; site-level MW was not disclosed.

name: Swisscom Basel-Grosspeter Data Center
notes: Swisscom's official data-center page lists Basel-Grosspeter among its seven Swiss business data centers. DataCenterMap places Swisscom Basel-Grosspeter at Grosspeteranlage 15 in Basel; no public site-level MW capacity was found.

name: senseLAN Duedingen data centers (Bonnstrasse 20 and Duensstrasse 1)
notes: senseLAN's official data-center page markets Tier 3 rackspace in Fribourg near the A12 and states it operates two data centers in Duedingen: Bonnstrasse 20, opened in 2010 with 800 m2 and four times the first site's area, and Duensstrasse 1. Inflect separately lists senseLAN B20 and D01 in Fribourg. No public MW capacity was found.

name: NorthC Geneva / The Hive Meyrin data center
notes: NorthC says it will build a new data center at The Hive campus outside Geneva, starting in Q1 of the announcement year and completing by Q2 2028. The facility is planned for 4.5 MW total IT capacity delivered in 1.5 MW phases, 5,400 m2 floor area, 100% green power, water-free cooling, HVO100 backup generators, and residual-heat reuse readiness.

name: Infomaniak Geneva data center
notes: DCD reported Infomaniak launched a 1,800 m2 Geneva data center housing about 10,000 servers, using Nvidia L4/A100/H100 GPUs, with PUE 1.09 and heat-recovery capacity of 1.7 MW into a district-heating network. The 1.7 MW figure is heat supplied, not IT load, so capacity_mw is null.

name: nLighten Geneva edge data center
notes: nLighten's official Geneva page describes an operational high-availability edge data center in northeast Geneva, about 10 minutes from Geneva airport, with 5,595 m2 of dedicated colocation space and 9,600 kW of power.

name: Equinix Geneva GV1 and GV2 data centers
notes: Equinix's official Geneva page lists GV1 Geneva and GV2 Le Lignon as active Geneva colocation data centers serving telecom and internet providers. Public page did not disclose site-level MW capacity.

name: STACK Infrastructure Geneva campus (GEN02 / GEN03)
notes: STACK's official Geneva page markets renewable-powered Geneva data centers and lists Geneva campus facilities including GEN02 and GEN03. Public page did not disclose MW capacity.

name: ungleich Data Center Light, Linthal
notes: Data Center Light's official site says it hosts Swiss VPS, colocation, backup, Matrix and Nextcloud services in Switzerland and operates on 99.9% hydropower plus 0.1% solar power. DataCenterPlatform places Data Center Light at Bahnhofstrasse 1, Linthal, 8783, operated by Ungleich Glarus AG. No public MW capacity found.

name: exigo redundant data centers in Chur and Malans
notes: exigo's official page states it operates two data centers in Graubunden: one in the exigo business building in Chur and a second in Malans. The page presents the paired sites as redundant server rooms/data centers for regional cloud and IT services; no public MW capacity found.

name: Kantonsspital Graubunden integrated data center, Chur
notes: SCHERLER's project reference states the new Kantonsspital Graubunden building in Chur includes an integrated Tier III-standard data center with dual medium-voltage supplies and backup generation. Inside IT reported in 2024 that the hospital would need to give up its second data-center site in Chur by mid-2026 and was seeking cloud disaster-recovery replacement; the integrated hospital data center is treated as operational but no MW capacity was disclosed.
